_doc: The harness's gate packs (H-E14 v0.1). `boot` is small and blocking: it runs at boot and against every candidate generation before it is promoted, and it must carry the three real defects (defect: contradicting_context, absent_role, wrong_role). `regression` is the larger offline pack. `sentinel` is held out and never harvested (Preflight.exclude_from_harvest). Bars are owner-signed with the config; the harness never moves one. Facts here are the serve store's own (load_sample seed 0) -- replace the asks when the store changes; the shape stays.
